'''Paros''' is a male NPC noble of Septimont, found behind the [[Ephor's Palace]]. He can be found talking with other nobles, '''Amphion''' and '''Flaviola'''.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:;'''Paros''' I bet those Ragunna fools wouldn't last a minute in a fight. What do you think?
:;'''Amphion''' Oh, for sure. That Order of theirs does nothing but pray to the Divinity.
:;'''Flaviola''' How do you expect to protect your own people with just prayers?

==Dialogue==
;(Talk to Paros)
:'''Paros''': If the Sentinel truly watches over these lands, They would surely need warriors worthy of fighting at Their side.
:'''Amphion''': Hmph. Only those with strength of will deserve that honor. Blind faith will be the death of the Rinascitans. It's already caused Ragunna to grow stagnant. 
:'''Flaviola''': The Ragunnesi leaders are hopelessly conservative. In strength, in vision, in presence—they can't hold a candle to our Ephor.
:'''Paros''':What are your thoughts on the matter, friend? Why can't they see it? That only someone as powerful as our Ephor has the right to lead?
:{{DIcon}} The Ragunnesi bear a heavy burden.
::'''Paros''': We're all Rinascitans, and yet the divide between us runs so deep...
::'''Paros''': If The Order keeps tightening its grip, Ragunna will cut itself off entirely, and with it, the spirit of our people will wither.
:{{DIcon}} Praise Septimont. Praise the Ephor!
::'''Paros''': Well said! You truly a person of wisdom! Praise Septimont! Praise the Ephor!
::'''Paros''': Strength and glory. These virtues must course through ever Rinascitan's veins! Only the strong can lead our people forward!
:{{DIcon}} Me no understand. I not from here. (mumble gibberish)
::'''Paros''': An outlander? Then I must introduce you to the many tales of our great Ephor...
{{Dialogue End}}
